name: Nate Lawson
source: Nate is the school’s biggest star in academics and athletics. He’s also assumed to be the best-behaved. Faculty trust him so completely that he’s allowed to enforce rules on other students. He will not hesitate to bring down judgement. Sometimes that means detention, sometimes execution. While he insists that most people leave him alone to focus on his endless list of tasks, Nate is desperate to keep the few people he is friends with. Though they can't get too close.
